payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the design and objectives of the path-based models, specifically hypo2path, which contribute to their success.

claims.text: The hypo2path model's success is attributed to its approach of treating hypernym prediction as a sequence generation task, which allows for the generation of entire hypernym paths rather than just direct hypernyms.
Using a standard LSTM-based sequence-to-sequence model with attention mechanisms enhances the model's ability to learn complex relationships in the hypernym taxonomy.
The model's training objective of predicting entire hypernym paths is more challenging, which may lead to a stronger overall performance compared to simpler models.
